column1: # CryptoPulse crypto slang lexicon - overlay for the on-device VADER scorer (UTF-8, tab separated).
# Format (one entry per line; a Python twin in the cloud sentiment hub reads this same file):
#   - Lines starting with '#' are comments. Blank lines are ignored.
#       term     lowercase. Either one token as VADER tokenizes it (split on whitespace, no spaces:
#                "hodl", "sell-off") or a multi-word phrase whose words are separated by exactly one
#                space ("rug pull"). Phrases are matched case-insensitively on whole words by
#                CryptoTextNormalizer and stored in the merged lexicon under the underscore key
#       valence  decimal number in [-4, 4] on VADER's scale (good = 1.9, great = 3.1, bad = -2.5,
#                scam = -2.7 in VADER). Crypto values replace vader_lexicon.txt values for the same key.
#       comment  optional free text. It must not start with "emoji_".
#       A third column starting with "emoji_" marks an emoji entry. The emoji (one or more code points)
#       is rewritten to the token emoji_<name> before scoring and that token gets the valence. Several
#       emoji may share one token (for example with and without the U+FE0F variation selector).
#   - Overlapping phrases chain: '_' is not a word character for the phrase matcher, so when two
#     phrases share words ("strong buy" + "buy signal") the text becomes ONE token
#     ("strong_buy_signal") that scores 0 unless it is an entry itself. Add the combined phrase for
#     every overlap that occurs in real posts; CryptoLexiconTest lists the overlaps left unscored.
#                   if " " in term and term not in phrases:
